source_record.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
source_record.problem: 框架搜索可能把同题反复试验误写为可迁移改进，且未与相同反馈权限下的简单搜索比较。
source_record.insight: 分开共享框架演化与单任务框架适应；将搜索和最终评估任务隔离，并明确不同实验的预算单位。
source_record.method: Terminal-Bench 2.1 uses three models, K=5 rollout rounds, two runs, and a 45/10/34 split; games compare task-specific adaptation against fixed-harness refinement.
source_record.result: The held-out mean is 63.2 for both initial and evolved harnesses. Game adaptation can help under action or wall-clock caps; those caps are not equal FLOPs.
source_record.limitation: Only one AHE-based implementation with external exploration disabled; small held-out set and two runs. Terminal editing cost excluded; ARC internal reasoning outside action cap; EdgeBench best-so-far includes host-only evaluations. No complete version diff or independent replication.
source_record.sections_read: Primary arXiv metadata/history; v4 §§1–5, Tables 1–9, A.1 cost/configuration/metrics, A.3 larger-budget controls, B.1 action accounting and B.2 artifact use, C.1 protocol/cost and Table 15. Case studies B.3 only partly read; no code/figure audit.
source_record.changes_existing_conclusion: Adds feedback access and held-out harness transfer to T5 budget accounting; does not reverse existing conditional test-time scaling claims.
source_record.evidence_status: First release July 14, latest revision October 5, so this is a window-eligible revision of older work, not an October first publication. Reading did not establish which claims were introduced by v3/v4.

recommended_body_additions.placement: T5 §4 after SELF-POT, as a short subsection on feedback access, harness search and generalization; optionally cross-link T6 evaluation discussion.
recommended_body_additions.proposal_zh: 当额外推理还会改写 agent 的提示、工具或记忆，问题就变成：它改善了可复用的执行框架（harness），还是仅适应了正在评测的任务？Wang 等在 10 月修订稿中区分这两个目标。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，他们以五轮 rollout、两次运行比较三个模型；按 45/10/34 题划分训练、验证和测试后，演化框架的平均留出成绩仍为 63.2。这是 rollout 预算比较，并非总 FLOPs 相同：框架编辑成本未计入。负面结果也有条件。针对单个任务的适应能改善游戏成绩，但 ARC-AGI-3 限制的是环境动作，不含内部推理；EdgeBench 则采用包含总结与编辑的 12 小时时限。后者还报告运行中观察到的最高分，包括未向 agent 展示的主机端评分，并非盲选最终提交。这要求分别报告反馈权限、搜索成本、留出迁移和选择协议；单题收益与这一有限负面结果，都不能确立可复用 agent 改进的普适定律。
recommended_body_additions.proposal_en: Once extra inference also rewrites an agent’s prompts, tools, or memory, the question is whether it improves a reusable harness or merely adapts to the evaluated tasks. Wang et al. separate these objectives in their October revision. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, they compare three models using five rollout rounds and two runs; a 45/10/34 train/validation/test split leaves the evolved harness’s mean held-out score unchanged at 63.2. This is a rollout-budget comparison, not equal total FLOPs: harness-editing cost is excluded. The negative result is conditional. Task-specific adaptation improves game scores, but ARC-AGI-3 caps environment actions, excluding internal reasoning, whereas EdgeBench uses a 12-hour window that includes summarization and editing. EdgeBench also reports the best score observed, including host-side evaluations hidden from the agent; this is not blind selection of a final submission. The implication is to report feedback access, search cost, held-out transfer, and selection protocol separately. Neither task-specific gains nor this limited negative result establish a general law for reusable agent improvement.
evidence_locator: §4.1: 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks, three models, K=5, two runs
A.1 Cost: harness modification cost excluded
B.1: ARC budget2000 play/environment actions, internal reasoning/read-only inspection outside score
C.1 Cost: EdgeBench12h includes summaries/edits; agent idle during updates
C.1 Dataset/Table15: best-so-far including agent-hidden host evaluations
cautions: Do not call K=5 FLOPs-matched or claim all harness evolution fails.
Do not read ARC headline80% as energy/FLOPs efficiency; do not transfer it to deployment without the feedback/action protocol.
Do not report EdgeBench best-so-far as agent-blind final-output selection.
This week's read does not establish a v3→v4 substantive change; the record is newly discovered locally.

source_record.title: Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment
source_record.problem: 全流量监控若重新编码长对话，验证器计算开销会限制覆盖率。
source_record.insight: 在回答后复用已有 KV cache 生成短评估，将强分类器的政策判断经 SFT/RL 蒸馏到提供服务的模型。
source_record.method: Synthetic conversations labeled by a Mythos Preview prompted teacher; assessment-only SFT plus schema and teacher-agreement rewards; offline screening after each response.
source_record.result: Reported production estimate under 2% added inference compute. At 1% teacher-defined FPR, Fable 5 recalls 78% of teacher flags and 94% of priority>=7 flags.
source_record.limitation: Teacher supplies both training and evaluation labels, so blind spots are not independently measured. Four-size SFT-only study uses a separate evaluation set without disclosed parameter counts or power-law fit. Not robust to a targeted adaptive attacker; no independent hardware/cost audit.
source_record.sections_read: Official report Introduction, Method/Training/Data, all Results subsections, Discussion/Limitations and footnotes; figures read through textual explanations, not digitized.
source_record.changes_existing_conclusion: Engineering example of marginal verification cost and correlated errors; no T5 body change recommended this week.
source_record.evidence_status: Publication date printed October 16, 2026. No revision history shown. Production recall is agreement with an automated teacher, not human-ground-truth detection; four-model scaling experiment cannot be combined with the production result.

recommended_index_only.why_no_body_change: Cache reuse and teacher blind spots make a useful engineering example, but existing T5 already distinguishes verification cost and correlated error. Budget/transfer harness evidence is more consequential this week.

reviewed_candidates.title: CARET: Training-Free Test-Time Scaling for Repository-Level Code Completion
reviewed_candidates.sections_read: II–VI methods, setup, Tables I–VI and validity discussion; no artifact/code rerun or figure audit.
reviewed_candidates.mechanism: Route between retrieval contexts using candidate agreement, reuse prefix cache, then rank distinct completions by likelihood of existing right-hand code plus normalized votes; fixed DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B scorer.
reviewed_candidates.conditions: Six 1.1B–7B generators, three Python line/API benchmarks; ten samples per consulted context, temperature0.8/top-p0.95/max64tokens. H100 NVL96GB; timing40prompts/benchmark. Primary context selected using10%development set, main table reports fullsets.
reviewed_candidates.limits: Right context is available to selection while generators are left-to-right; no fill-in-the-middle comparator. ~1.45x is forward-token accounting with caching, excluding retrieval; reported end-to-end vs BM25 is1.9–3.1x. EM is not functional correctness; one sampling run.
internal_discrepancies: Table V has reverse-likelihood31.54 below majority31.97 on CrossCodeEval, despite nearby claim it beats majority on every benchmark.
Table VI routing-on entries differ from Table I for the same model/benchmark (e.g. DS6.7B CrossCodeEval39.83 vs39.55); run/protocol distinction not reconciled in inspected text.
Main latency table values are benchmark means; prose1.3–2.9x and end-to-end1.9–3.1x use different scopes and cannot be interchanged.
reviewed_candidates.decision: Keep in weekly candidate log; no canonical/body upgrade.
reviewed_candidates.next_check: Reconcile table/run protocols and audit released cost counts, caching implementation, retrieval denominator and right-context/FIM-matched baseline.
